subject: Is there a way to use ggvis in index.html for shiny?

messages.author: 40878654752107e5
messages.subject: Is there a way to use ggvis in index.html for shiny?
parts: I've switched from using ui.R to using index.html exclusively.  The problem is with when I try to output a ggvis plot it opens an entire new html page in addition to my current html page.  The new page only shows the ggvis plot.  For normal charts, graphs, tables, html, I create a div and assign it the id and class of "shiny-plot-output", "shiny-datatable-output", etc.
